credit_cards.description: Synthetic credit-card transactions, product variants, customer segments, monthly INR profitability, funding/credit costs, delinquency exposures and roll-rate cohorts.
relationships: Risk tables join on month, variant_id, segment, currency and bucket; aggregate each grain before joining.
notes: Financial facts are synthetic INR card-month values for January-June 2026; the original three Parquet files are unchanged.
Monthly P&L is a separate accounting grain. Its approved_net_spend_inr reconciles to approved INR transactions; other financial inputs are explicit synthetic assumptions, not FX conversions.
Diners Black is a fictional analytical variant label assigned in cc_card_profiles, not a claim about the original network/card_tier or real product economics.
Risk cohorts are synthetic aggregate transition observations, not account-level trajectories or audited provision movements.

Monthly financials now include ENR/ANR split, balance-based transactor/revolve shares, calibrated annual revolve yield, PBT, synthetic tax and PAT. Flat-cost PAT and COF/yield/transactor-share NIM sensitivities have different assumptions; follow the explicit question.

transactor_share_pct_pt_change is an absolute percentage-point change: +5 adds 0.05 to transactor_share at fixed total ANR. The tax fixture assumes 25% with loss benefits recognized; it is not statutory tax guidance.
